rdfs:label: sharedInbox
rdfs:comment: An ActivityPub Actor-server endpoint that accepts deliveries for any local recipient — used to deduplicate fan-out when one Activity targets many followers on the same server.
notes: Lives inside an Actor's `as:endpoints` object. Federation pattern: when delivering an Activity addressed to many followers, a sender SHOULD POST once to each receiving server's `sharedInbox` rather than once per follower's per-Actor `inbox` — saves bandwidth and quadratic delivery cost on large fediverse instances.
